say:0:1611017001:0.source_cn: 你找了一处安静的地方，仔细思考着目前取得的五条信息碎片...

say:1:1611017002:1.text: Merlin's secret tower, meteor showers and the Starshower spell, a magic door that needs special conditions to open, the Memory Star, and... the Arcane Council.

say:5:1611017004:0.text: You realize the true goal of this exam might not be the title of court mage at all, but to uncover classified information from the Arcane Council.
say:5:1611017004:0.source_cn: 获得魔法师协会的机密信息——看来这才是宫廷魔法师选拔的...
